preconditions.description: The number of files is between 1 and 500, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each file name is a string with at least 1 and at most 8 lower case letters 'a' to 'z'.
preconditions.description: The names of the files are valid and within the specified constraints.

preconditions.expression: Each file imports at least one other file and no file imports the same file more than once.
preconditions.description: The import statements are valid and follow the specified rules.

postconditions.expression: If there are no cyclic dependencies, output 'SHIP IT'.
postconditions.description: The output indicates the absence of cyclic dependencies.

postconditions.expression: If there are cyclic dependencies, output the names of files in a shortest cycle, in the order of the cycle.
postconditions.description: The output identifies the shortest cycle of files with cyclic dependencies.
